DeploymentType.description:
Deployment type to deploy this stack
Valid values are: 0 - 'compose', 1 - 'kubernetes'
compose is enabled only for docker environments
kubernetes is enabled only for kubernetes environments

FilePathInRepository.description: Path to the Stack file inside the Git repository

Name.description:
Name of the stack
Max length: 255
Name must only contains lowercase characters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores
Name must start with a lowercase character or number
Example: stack-name or stack_123 or stackName

Registries.description: List of Registries to use for this stack

RepositoryAuthentication.description: Use basic authentication to clone the Git repository

RepositoryAuthorizationType.description: RepositoryAuthorizationType is the authorization type to use

RepositoryPassword.description: Password used in basic authentication. Required when RepositoryAuthentication is true.

RepositoryReferenceName.description: Reference name of a Git repository hosting the Stack file

RepositoryURL.description: URL of a Git repository hosting the Stack file

RepositoryUsername.description: Username used in basic authentication. Required when RepositoryAuthentication is true.

TLSSkipVerify.description: TLSSkipVerify skips SSL verification when cloning the Git repository

UseManifestNamespaces.description: Uses the manifest's namespaces instead of the default one
